05-01-start: Construct with two manager panes: xp (small, ahead, labelled XP) and a dark-grey tiling pane to the right; OPEN CUBE chip bottom right. Panes are small at the start distance.
05-02-xp-view: After the camera glide (a method call, not a walk) the xp desktop fills about a third of the screen; the tiling pane is cut at the right edge and now black.
05-03-xp-start-menu: A click on Start inside the pane opens the xp Start menu in the pane (no fly-in needed). The pane shows only Terminal in the program list (default programs).
05-04-xp-terminal: Terminal opened inside the xp pane and fills the whole pane (maximised, no desktop visible); shell prompt root@vm:/home/user/notes#.
05-05-xp-typed: Typed echo hello from xp shows in the xp terminal and the shell answers hello from xp; the window still fills the pane (title bar foot, task button).
05-06-tiling-view: Glide to the tiling pane; it is black (empty tiling session, no bar).
05-07-tiling-click: A click into the black tiling pane: a blue edge lights, no other change.
05-08-tiling-terminal: Super+Return inside the pane opens a foot terminal in tiling that fills the pane. Surprising: the camera moved by itself, the pane now sits at the left of the picture instead of the middle (the view followed the new window).
05-09-tiling-typed: Typed echo hello from tiling and the shell answers hello from tiling.
05-10-both: Glide back to the start pose; both panes in view with their terminals.
